description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #7: PATCH restricted:false, sent by the per-DSN admin (udu, not session.Admin), succeeds and the server unconditionally cascades to delete every permission record for this DSN -- both udu's own admin grant (dsns-94e) and udx's unrelated read grant (dsns-94i). The CLI's --force confirmation gate is a client-side safeguard only; the endpoint itself never refuses this transition.
